ache.title: Two archetypes for Simona, two ways to invest
ache.note: Nero first thought Simona was a plain tank, then found her skills split into two archetypes around ‘Winter is Coming’ and Winter’s End. Clever kit, honestly. It also means two builds and two sets of gear to chase. ‘Is she the right addition to your team?’ is a question the game hopes you answer with yes.
watch: PvP pushing you to keep up
ache.tip: Pick one way to play a unit you already have and stick with it. One good build is plenty.
lines: winter is coming. so is the next banner

videoData.title: Character Discussion: Simona | Sword of Convallaria

textData.text: In this video, I dive into the character Simona from Sword of Convallaria. Initially, I thought she was just a straightforward tank, but her unique skills define two distinct archetypes. Her talent 'Winter is Coming' grants a significant shield and various buffs. Skills like Ice-Forged Armor, Cryonics, and Winter's End are discussed, highlighting their importance in both PvE and PvP. I also share gameplay tactics and build suggestions to maximize her potential. Join me for a detailed breakdown of Simona's abilities and how to use her effectively. Enjoy the intricate animations and let’s see if Simona is the right addition to your team.
